title.narrative: Increasing competitiveness through enhanced quality and compliance along the onion value chain

description.narrative: As part of the West Africa Competitiveness Programme, the overall objective of the project is to strengthen the competitiveness of The Gambia and enhance its integration into the regional and international trading system. The specific objective is to improve the performance, growth and contribution to industry, regional trade and exports of onion and other horticulture VC .
